finding.claim: The duration count is parsed outside the try, with a Unicode \d. A count of more than 4300 digits (for example '9'*5000 + 'd') makes int() raise ValueError, and kmctl new prints a traceback instead of a refusal. A non-ASCII digit such as '٣d' is accepted as 3 days.

fixes.change: The duration count takes ASCII digits only, at most six, so a huge or non-ASCII count is refused with the --stale-after message instead of crashing or being read.
A 5000-digit count, an Arabic-Indic digit and a seven-digit count are refused naming --stale-after.
